description: Lightweight PDF-centric AI LaTeX workspace inside VS Code: draw boxes on compiled PDFs, map via SyncTeX, revise with AI, and review typeset before/after diffs.
untrustedWorkspaces.description: In untrusted workspaces Texel only shows an existing PDF. Compiling LaTeX, running AI revisions, and loading workspace skills from .texel/skills require a trusted workspace.
command.openPreview: Texel: Open PDF Annotator & AI Workspace
command.compileAndPreview: Texel: Compile LaTeX & Open PDF Workspace
config.language.description: Interface language for the Texel PDF workspace: auto (follow VS Code language), en (English), or zh-CN (Simplified Chinese).
config.aiProvider.description: AI backend used for LaTeX revisions: vscode-lm (IDE built-in / Copilot), openai-compatible (HTTP API), or cli (local agent CLI).
config.apiBaseUrl.description: Base URL for OpenAI-compatible API requests (when texel.aiProvider is openai-compatible).
config.apiKey.description: API key for OpenAI-compatible API requests (when texel.aiProvider is openai-compatible).
config.apiKey.deprecation: Use command **Texel: Set API Key (Secure Storage)** instead to store your key in VS Code SecretStorage.
config.model.description: Model name for openai-compatible or preferred family hint for vscode-lm.
config.cliCommand.description: Local CLI agent command to pipe prompts to (when texel.aiProvider is cli).
config.texBinPath.description: Directory containing latexmk, synctex, and latexdiff binaries (put first on PATH if it exists).
